model_description: A binary classification model that estimates the probability that an incident will exceed the target SLA of 5 days.
business_purpose: Help support and quality teams quickly identify incidents at risk of exceeding the SLA deadline.
target_definition: SLA_BREACH is 1 when an incident's resolution time exceeds 5 days, otherwise 0.
limitations: Results depend on the quality and representativeness of the training data.
The prediction is a statistical estimate and does not guarantee that an incident will actually breach its SLA.
Model performance should be regularly reevaluated to detect potential data drift.
